               MOTION TO RECONSIDER SOAH ORDER NO. 24 -
               MCP18 LLC AND NICOLE (NIKKI) SEGAL (SEGA)

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:
     COMES NOW, MCP18 LLC and Nicole Segal to file this Motion to Reconsider
SOAH Order No. 25 and in support thereof respectfully show:

                                     Introduction

       On April 9, 2026, SOAH Order No. 2 granted MCP18 LLC’s motion to
intervene. (Interchange Item No. 343)
       On May 13, 2026, Brian C. Andrews filed direct testimony in this proceeding,
sponsored by Glenn Hodge and Ryan Hodge, JT Carothers Holdings, LLC, MCP 18
LLC, and Schwertner Farms, Inc. (Interchange Item No. 4332)
        On May 13, 2026, Save Our Salado (SOS) filed the Joint Position Statement of
over fifty people, including Jeffrey and Nicole Segal. (Interchange Item No. 4389)
       On May 13, 2026, Nicole and Jeffrey Segal filed direct testimony. (Interchange
No. 4348)
        On May 15, 2026, SOAH Order No. 14 granted the request to intervene of over
fifty people who appointed Save Our Salado (SOS) their authorized representative.
Nicole L. Segal is included in SOAH Order No. 13. (Interchange Item No. 4679)


                                            1
         On May 15, 2026, Applicants filed a list of intervenors who allegedly did not file
direct testimony or a statement of position. MCP18 LLC and Nicole “Sega” were
included on that list. (Interchange Item No. 4688)
         On May 19, 2026, Applicants filed a corrected list of intervenors who allegedly did
not file direct testimony or a statement of position. Nicole “Sega” was included on that
list, but MCP18 LLC was not. (Interchange Item No. 4766)
       On May 26, 2026, MCP18 LLC and Nicole Segal (“Sega”) filed a Response to
Applicants’ List of Intervenors Who Did not File Testimony or Statement of Position.
(Interchange Item No. 5146)
       On June 1, 2026, the ALJs issued SOAH Order No. 24 – Ruling on Intervenor
Motions, Granting Leave for Late-Filed Testimonies, and Dismissing Intervenors
(Interchange Item No. 5330)

                                         Argument

        MCP18 LLC is a sponsor of the Direct testimony of Brian C. Andrews. MCP18
LLC thus qualifies as having filed testimony in this proceeding and should not be stricken
as an intervenor.
        Intervenor Nicole (“Nikki”) Segal (“Sega” in Applicants’ filings) is associated
with the Save Our Salado (SOS) group and is listed on the group’s Joint Position
Statement. Ms. Segal also filed direct testimony. Ms. Segal thus qualifies as having filed
direct testimony and a statement of position in this proceeding and should not be stricken
as an intervenor.

                                        Conclusion

       Intervenors MCP18 LLC and Nicole Segal should not have been included on the
Applicants’ lists of intervenors who did not file testimony or a statement of position and
should not be dismissed from this proceeding. MCP18 and Segal filed a response to the
Applicants’ filings but were dismissed as intervenors. MCP18 and Segal request the ALJs
reconsider dismissing them from this proceeding in SOAH Order No. 24 and reinstate
them with full rights as intervenors.




              MCP18 LLC and Nicole Segal; Motion to Reconsider SOAH Order No. 24
